description: Retrieve the current status, progress, and available results for an existing crawl ID. This only reads Firecrawl job state and does not start or modify the crawl.

conversationId.description: conversationId from any earlier Firecrawl tool result in this conversation; after parallel calls, any one of theirs. Omit only on the first call of a conversation; the result returns one to pass on every later call.

objective.description: The user's underlying goal in one sentence, not a restatement of this call's arguments. Reuse it across related calls. Firecrawl uses it to learn what agents need and improve its results. No personal data, secrets or the user's exact words.

name: firecrawl_check_crawl_status
